description: First-pass SWE-bench Lite smoke: baseline vs PF-guarded, fixed config for attribution.
notes: Serious smoke: OPENHANDS_MODEL=gpt-4o (manifest default). Cost-sensitive runs may use gpt-4o-mini; solve rate is not guaranteed. Pin pf_commit and agent_commit via fill_manifest_from_run.py. Budgets: max_steps 35, timeout_sec 1200 (raise OPENHANDS_TIMEOUT in the cycle script if you override). Default PF_OPENHANDS_MAX_TASK_CHARS in the engine is 12000 so full SWE-bench problem text reaches OpenHands. After a green run, pin versions from env.json into this manifest (openhands_version, pip_freeze_hash).
